events.comment: Template: a fight-ready Moonlit Ruins arena with no boss. To make a new fight, duplicate this scene, add the boss objects, put them in the Enemy and EnemyHitbox groups, and link the boss's events sheet at the end.
Shared combat rules. Runs before the Samurai events so they can react on the same frame.
Scene start: hide the red Invisible_Wall colliders. The Samurai sheet does this in his scenes, but this scene does not include it.
Arena: Moonlit Ruins ambience (moon glow, drifting clouds and fog, fireflies). Its objects are in the "Arena Moonlit Ruins" folder, on the Background layer behind the floor.
